import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class P1575D {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        MyScanner scanner = new MyScanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        char[] s = scanner.nextToken().toCharArray();
        int ans = 0;

        if (s.length == 1) {
            if (s[0] == '0' || s[0] == '_' || s[0] == 'X') {
                ans = 1;
            }
        } else {
            int n = s.length;
            if (!(s[n - 1] == 'X' && s[n - 2] == 'X')) {
                // put 25

                    put(s1, n - 1, '5');
                    put(s1, n - 2, '2');
                    ans += possible(s1);
                }
                // put 50
                if (canPut(s, n - 1, '0') && canPut(s, n - 2, '5')) {
                    char[] s1 = s.clone();
                    put(s1, n - 1, '0');
                    put(s1, n - 2, '5');
                    ans += possible(s1);
                }
                // put 75
                if (canPut(s, n - 1, '5') && canPut(s, n - 2, '7')) {
                    char[] s1 = s.clone();
                    put(s1, n - 1, '5');
                    put(s1, n - 2, '7');
                    ans += possible(s1);
                }
            }
            // put 00
            if (s[n - 1] == 'X' && s[n - 2] == 'X') {
                char[] s1 = s.clone();
                put(s1, n - 1, '0');
                ans += possible(s1);
            } else if (canPut(s, n - 1, '0') && canPut(s, n - 2, '0')) {
                char[] s1 = s.clone();
                put(s1, n - 1, '0');
                put(s1, n - 2, '0');
                ans += possible(s1);
            }
        }
        writer.println(ans);

        writer.flush();
    }

    private static boolean canPut(char[] s, int p, char d) {
        return s[p] == 'X' || s[p] == '_' || s[p] == d;
    }

    private static void put(char[] s, int p, char d) {
        if (s[p] == 'X') {
            replace(s, d);
        } else {
            s[p] = d;
        }
    }

    private static void replace(char[] s, char d) {
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
            if (s[i] == 'X') {
                s[i] = d;
            }
        }
    }

    private static int possible(char[] s) {
        int p = 1;

        if (s[0] == '0') {
            return 0;
        }
        if (s[0] == '_') {
            p *= 9;
        } else if (s[0] == 'X') {
            p *= 9;
            replace(s, '1');
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < s.length; i++) {
            if (s[i] == '_') {
                p *= 10;
            } else if (s[i] == 'X') {
                p *= 10;
                replace(s, '1');
            }
        }

        return p;
    }

    private static class MyScanner {
        private BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        public MyScanner(InputStream inputStream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream));
        }

        private String nextToken() throws IOException {
            while(st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                st = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(nextToken());
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            return Long.parseLong(nextToken());
        }
    }
}
